brief_summary: Prevention and treatment strategies for diabetes use exercise as the cornerstone. Even though endurance training and strength training both improve insulin resistance, strength training may be better suited for persons at risk for type 2 diabetes. We will expand our pilot studies of muscle adaptation induced by resistance exercise training to determine the biochemical mechanisms that will cause people with the Metabolic Syndrome to secure major benefit from intense strength training.
brief_title: Mechanisms by Which Strength Training Ameliorates the Metabolic Syndrome
collaborators: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK)
